fields.description: Palace Residences in Dubai Hills Estate combines three residential towers with three-bedroom townhouses. Its setting connects residents with the district’s park, mall and business park, while a landscaped podium provides shared leisure space at home. Apartments range from one to three bedrooms, with balconies or terraces that vary considerably between floors and layouts.

overview: The brochure describes three towers arranged around a shared landscaped setting. The interiors draw on the Palace brand’s design language, with an earthy colour palette and contemporary detailing. Recreation includes indoor and outdoor exercise, yoga, children’s play, a multipurpose room and areas to gather beside the pool. The park and mall broaden the neighbourhood’s facilities, but golf-club or other paid memberships are not established as part of the purchase.
research.locationNote: The address is within Dubai Hills Estate, near Dubai Hills Park, Dubai Hills Mall and the business park. Al Khail Road provides access to the wider city. Emaar’s references to planned rail and Metro connections are future proposals, not confirmation of a current station serving the development.
research.priceNote: Emaar advertises AED 1.76m. The May 2024 launch sheet gives category starts of AED 1.76m, AED 2.59m and AED 3.58m for one, two and three bedrooms, and AED 6.26m for townhouses. Current availability and an individual quotation require confirmation.
research.paymentNote: The launch schedule totals 80% before completion and 20% at completion, including a 10% booking payment. Property Finder reports the same 10/70/20 split. Historical dates do not describe the outstanding balance of a resale unit.
research.handoverNote: April 2028 is the estimated completion in the launch payment sheet and Property Finder. Confirm the current construction programme and contractual date before purchase.

facts.label: Published development total
facts.value: The launch fact sheet lists 962 apartments and townhouses combined. This is a development total, not a statement of current inventory.

facts.label: Townhouse layout
facts.value: Type A.1 has one bedroom and a maid’s room downstairs, with two bedrooms upstairs. TH01 totals 2,296.27 sq ft; TH03 totals 2,302.51 sq ft. Both plans show a terrace, upstairs balcony and separate laundry.

facts.label: Terrace-sensitive sizing
facts.value: Building 1 three-bedroom unit 103 totals 1,820.39 sq ft, including a 465.97 sq ft terrace. Compare internal suite area separately when assessing it against a typical upper-floor home.
